message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: Defendant bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from someone, then fraudulently induced victim to invest 5 million RMB promising high profit from selling artifacts. He used money for personal use, gave back 1 million and some low-value artifacts. This is fraud (骗取财物). Also dealing in illegal cultural relics: illegal acquisition, sale, or trafficking of cultural relics. The charge likely "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trade of cultural relics) and "诈骗罪". In examples, they label as "诈骗罪" and maybe "非法买卖文物". The prompt says "构成××和诈骗罪". So answer should include two crimes: illegal trade of cultural relics (非法买卖文物) and fraud (诈骗). Use format: [罪名]非法买卖文物;诈骗<eoa>.
